title: 第12章 结阵第13章 这手段了得
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
紧随张远踏出的是持着圆盾的陈梁。
一手圆盾，一手短刀，陈梁在马车周围转一圈，目光落在车顶的张远身上，双目之中透出一丝惊异。
张远的动作，此时的姿态，都根本不像是个第一次参与镇抚司任务的新人。
其他三人陆续下车。
将长柄战斧握住的李长卫抬头，口中嘀咕一声：“真他娘的像……”
张全武瞪他一眼，持着长枪快速前行。
李长卫忙将长斧拖着，快步跟上。
孙泽身躯微微躬下，双手压在腰间，这是最适合出刀的姿势。
陈梁的圆盾在左手，将孙泽的半个身躯护住。
此时，张远已经跳下车顶，扣着三根箭矢，身形微侧，离着前方四人两丈多远，脚步轻捷。
前方陈梁微微回头，看到张远位置和身形，面上神色闪过惊讶。
孙泽回头看一眼，又转过头去。
“就是这里。”张全武停住身形，微微喘息的低语。
三十斤重甲，至少二十斤长枪，快速奔行两里路，可不是轻松事情。
货栈围墙之外，十丈小道，宽不过五尺。
小道尽头就是贵庐河。
“长兵用不上。”张全武低语一声，将手中长枪一横，双手交错。
“咔嚓。”长枪被拆成两截，一截是无锋的铁棒，一截是五尺短枪。
五尺巷，长兵施展不开。
另一边的李长卫也将长斧拆成短斧。

两人并肩，将五尺小道直接堵住。
手按刀柄的孙泽与持盾的陈梁在两人身后一丈。
张远则是在两丈之外，手持短弓。
“嘭——”
远处一道烟花直射天空，在十丈高处炸裂。
“巡卫军拿人，速速缚手——”
“弓箭手准备，三息不降，格杀勿论！”
“庐阳府府军在此，尔等插翅难飞！”
一道道声音响起，带着威严和冷厉。
远处一声声呼喝，显得似乎有千军万马来。
擒贼擒王，攻心为上。
战场上刀剑无眼，能不强攻便不强攻。
“嘭——”
重物冲撞的声音响起。
看来还是强攻了。
箭矢划破长空的尖利声响，夹杂着军卒冲锋的呼喊。
刀剑碰撞的沉闷声，更加沉闷的刀剑斩入身躯声音。
惨呼，痛吼。
小道之上，沉寂万分，唯有河道上的风灌入。
身穿重甲的两人已经满身汗透。

站在后方的张远能看到孙泽手掌不断摩挲，将掌心的汗抹在后背的衣衫上。
这一刻，张远感觉自己的听觉，视觉都细腻到极致。
周围柳条轻抚的声音，两只蜻蜓展翅飞过的痕迹，都被他捕捉到。
content_en:
Following Zhang Yuan was Chen Liang holding a round shield.
With a round shield in one hand and a short sword in the other, Chen Liang walked around the carriage and his eyes fell on Zhang Yuan on the roof, with a hint of surprise in his eyes.
Zhang Yuan's movements and posture at this time did not look like a newcomer participating in the Zhenfu Division mission for the first time.
The other three people got out of the car one after another.
Li Changwei, who was holding the long-handled battle ax, raised his head and muttered: "What a damn image..."
Zhang Quanwu glared at him and moved forward quickly with his spear in hand.
Li Changwei hurriedly dragged his long ax and followed quickly.
Sun Ze bowed slightly and put his hands on his waist. This was the most suitable posture for drawing a sword.
Chen Liang's round shield was in his left hand, protecting half of Sun Ze's body.
At this time, Zhang Yuan had jumped off the roof of the car, holding three arrows in his hand. His body was slightly sideways, more than two feet away from the four people in front, and his steps were light.
Chen Liang in front turned his head slightly and saw Zhang Yuan's position and figure, with a look of surprise on his face.
Sun Ze glanced back, then turned away.
"This is it." Zhang Quanwu stopped and whispered with a slight breath.
Running two miles quickly with thirty pounds of heavy armor and at least twenty pounds of spears is no easy task.
Outside the warehouse wall, there is a ten-foot path that is no more than five feet wide.
At the end of the trail is the Guilu River.
"There is no need for long soldiers." Zhang Quanwu whispered, crossed his spear and crossed his hands.
"Crack." The long spear was split into two parts, one was an iron rod without an edge, and the other was a five-foot short spear.
In Wuchi Alley, long soldiers cannot be deployed.
Li Changwei on the other side also dismantled the long ax into a short axe.
The two stood side by side, blocking the five-foot path.
Sun Ze, who was pressing the hilt of his sword, and Chen Liang, who was holding a shield, were ten feet behind them.
Zhang Yuan was two feet away, holding a short bow.
"Bang——"
A firework shot straight into the sky in the distance and exploded ten feet high.
"When the patrol takes someone, tie their hands quickly——"
"Archers, be prepared. If you don't surrender for three breaths, we will kill you without mercy!"
"The Luyang Prefecture's troops are here, you can't fly without your wings!"
Voices sounded one after another, with majesty and coldness.
There were shouts in the distance, and it seemed like thousands of troops were coming.
To capture the thief and capture the king, the most important thing is to capture the heart.
On the battlefield, swords have no eyes. If you can't attack with force, you won't attack with force.
"Bang——"
The sound of heavy objects colliding was heard.
It seems that they still attacked by force.
The sharp sound of arrows piercing the sky was mixed with the shouts of charging soldiers.
The dull sound of swords clashing, and the even duller sound of swords cutting into bodies.
Screaming and roaring in pain.
On the trail, it was extremely quiet, with only the wind from the river flowing in.
The two men wearing heavy armor were covered in sweat.
Standing behind, Zhang Yuan could see Sun Ze rubbing his palms continuously, wiping the sweat from his palms on the clothes on his back.
At this moment, Zhang Yuan felt that his hearing and vision were extremely delicate.
He captured the sound of the willow branches caressing around him and the traces of two dragonflies flying by with their wings spread.
